shots.caption: The Gilded Pleated Train walks last at the Summer Show. Five in the world.
Dressed the window of Lora's Spark in the Gilded Fan at dawn. Every pleat by hand.
The Original, the first Gilded Zip, before the line had a name.
PFTs are not speculative collectibles. They work for you, and all you need is a grand dream. 100 trillion Profile Fungible Tokens, set aside for every club, creator and member who ever hatches here.
